name: @requrv/remem
description: Decisional memory for AI agents — one entry (store), one exit (recall), with Qdrant, Neo4j and a file/knowledge index.
author: ReQurv

scripts.build: bun run build:js && bun run build:types
scripts.build:js: bun run build:js:core && bun run build:js:mcp && bun run build:js:cli
scripts.build:js:core: bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --format esm --target node --sourcemap --external=@qdrant/js-client-rest --external=neo4j-driver --external=zod --external=@aws-sdk/client-s3 && bun build src/index.ts --outdir tmp-cjs --format cjs --target node --sourcemap --external=@qdrant/js-client-rest --external=neo4j-driver --external=zod --external=@aws-sdk/client-s3 && mv tmp-cjs/index.js dist/index.cjs && mv tmp-cjs/index.js.map dist/index.cjs.map && rm -rf tmp-cjs
scripts.build:js:mcp: bun build src/mcp/index.ts --outdir dist/mcp --format esm --target node --sourcemap --external=@qdrant/js-client-rest --external=neo4j-driver --external=zod --external=@aws-sdk/client-s3 --external=@modelcontextprotocol/sdk --external=elysia && bun build src/mcp/index.ts --outdir tmp-mcp-cjs --format cjs --target node --sourcemap --external=@qdrant/js-client-rest --external=neo4j-driver --external=zod --external=@aws-sdk/client-s3 --external=@modelcontextprotocol/sdk --external=elysia && mv tmp-mcp-cjs/index.js dist/mcp/index.cjs && mv tmp-mcp-cjs/index.js.map dist/mcp/index.cjs.map && rm -rf tmp-mcp-cjs
scripts.build:js:cli: bun build src/mcp/cli.ts --outdir tmp-cli --format esm --target node --sourcemap --banner='#!/usr/bin/env node' --external=@qdrant/js-client-rest --external=neo4j-driver --external=zod --external=@aws-sdk/client-s3 --external=@modelcontextprotocol/sdk --external=elysia && mv tmp-cli/cli.js dist/remem-mcp.js && mv tmp-cli/cli.js.map dist/remem-mcp.js.map && rm -rf tmp-cli && bun build src/mcp/http-cli.ts --outdir tmp-http-cli --format esm --target node --sourcemap --banner='#!/usr/bin/env bun' --external=@qdrant/js-client-rest --external=neo4j-driver --external=zod --external=@aws-sdk/client-s3 --external=@modelcontextprotocol/sdk --external=elysia && mv tmp-http-cli/http-cli.js dist/remem-mcp-http.js && mv tmp-http-cli/http-cli.js.map dist/remem-mcp-http.js.map && rm -rf tmp-http-cli
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run build
